name: App Store
summary: App Store optimization and marketing skills for descriptions, screenshots, keywords, review responses, and comprehensive promotional strategy. Use when user needs help with App Store presence, ASO, marketing, or customer communication.

name: Apple Intelligence
summary: Apple Intelligence skills for on-device AI features including Foundation Models, Visual Intelligence, App Intents, and intelligent assistants. Use when implementing AI-powered features.

name: Design
summary: Design skills for Apple platform UI — Liquid Glass, animations, game feel (haptics, sound, celebrations), UI prototyping, UX writing, SF Symbols, and typography. name: Generators
summary: Code generator skills that produce production-ready Swift code for common app components. name: Ios Development
summary: Comprehensive iOS development guidance including Swift best practices, SwiftUI patterns, UI/UX review against HIG, and app planning. Use for iOS code review, best practices, accessibility audits, or planning new iOS apps.

name: Legal
summary: Legal document generation and compliance guidance for indie Apple developers. Covers privacy policies, terms of service, EULAs, GDPR/CCPA/DPDP compliance, and Apple App Store legal requirements. Use when user needs legal documents or compliance guidance.

name: Macos Development
summary: Comprehensive macOS development guidance including Swift 6+, SwiftUI, SwiftData, architecture patterns, AppKit bridging, and macOS 26 Tahoe APIs. Use for macOS code review, best practices, UI review, or platform-specific features.

name: Monetization
summary: Monetization strategy for iOS/macOS apps. Covers readiness assessment, pricing model selection, tier structuring, free trial strategy, and implementation guidance. Use when deciding what to charge, how to price, or planning monetization end-to-end.

name: Product Development
summary: End-to-end product development for iOS/macOS apps. Covers market research, competitive analysis, PRD generation, architecture specs, UX design, implementation guides, testing, and App Store release. Use for product planning, validation, or generating specification documents.

name: Release Review
summary: Senior developer-level release review for macOS/iOS apps. Identifies security, privacy, UX, and distribution issues with actionable fixes. Use when preparing an app for release, want a critical review, or before App Store submission.

name: Security
summary: Security category index for Apple platforms. Routes to the privacy-manifests skill. General secure-storage/biometrics/ATS guidance was retired in the 2026 blind-test audit — current models cover it natively.

name: Shared
summary: Platform-agnostic skills including skill creation templates and best practices. Use when creating new skills or improving existing ones.

name: Swift Development
summary: Swift language patterns and best practices including concurrency, performance, and modern idioms. Use for Swift language-level code review or architecture guidance.

name: Testing
summary: TDD and testing skills for iOS/macOS apps. Covers characterization tests, TDD workflows, test contracts, snapshot tests, test infrastructure, and deterministic quality gates (fitness functions, coverage ratchet, mutation testing). Use for test-driven development, adding tests to existing code, or building test infrastructure.

name: Watchos
